subject: how to map intensities to probe specific information

messages.author: 75dfe498b9a8bfd0
messages.subject: how to map intensities to probe specific information
parts:
Hi All:

I am new to aroma.affymetrix and to this topic. I am trying to do
some analysis using some raw data from exon arrays.

Is there a collection of all the commands and functions included in
this package available? I tried to search for a help document but did
not find a detailed one.

How can I extract the information of all the exons of a common
transcript cluster or gene? And how to map the intensity values in the
cel file to their corresponding exon IDs?

Thanks and Cheers!


hermione

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] how to map intensities to probe specific information
parts:
Hermione.

There is a vignette forthcoming (in the next week maybe?) that will
discuss many of these points for exon array analysis. Have you read
the Google groups site? There is a considerable amount of information
already there, including FAQs, examples, etc. Probably the best place
to start is:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web

Once you've read some of those, if you still have questions, let us
know.

Cheers,
Mark
